title: Pretence of Family

characters.name: Shinobu
key_moments: Arrives at Natagumo Mountain floating like a butterfly
Rescues Murata from spider thread acid cocoon
Confronts Spider Demon Sister with calm smile
Insect Breathing Butterfly Dance: Caprice (Chō no Mai: Tawamure)
Lethal Wisteria poison injection disintegrating the demon

characters.name: Giyu
key_moments: Intercepts Rui's cutting threads and shields Tanjiro
Water Breathing Eleventh Form: Dead Calm (Lull)
Nullifies Rui's Blood Demon Art effortlessly
One-shot decapitation of Lower Moon Five Rui

characters.name: Spider Sister
key_moments: Traps Demon Slayers in acid cocoons
Dissolved by lethal Wisteria flower poison

characters.name: Rui
key_moments: Prepares Cutting Thread Rotation to execute Tanjiro
Blood Demon Art: Cutting Thread Rotation
Decapitated by Eleventh Form Dead Calm

notes: Demon Slayer Season 1 Episode 20: Shinobu Kocho vs Spider Demon Sister & Giyu Tomioka Eleventh Form Dead Calm vs Rui

intro_dialogue.speaker: Shinobu
